about: Models on which a committed run ended with no incumbent, or with the dual bound at the optimum and the incumbent away from it. bench/runners/first_incumbent.py runs them, one arm per option. A case is an instance and the options every arm of it runs with; `instance` names the model when the case's own name is not it.

sources.closed-root: the root-bound work of draft PR #1244: with presolve_probing the root bound is at or near the optimum and no matching point is found

decomp2.why: dual bound at the optimum, incumbent away from it

neos-827175.why: dual bound at the optimum, incumbent away from it

cap6000.why: dual bound at the optimum, incumbent inside the 1e-4 gap but away from it

drayage-100-23+probing.why: root bound 103333.87, the published optimum, on every seed; best incumbent 128423

drayage-25-23+probing.why: root bound 99718.79 against the optimum 101282.65; incumbent 114467

mitre+probing.why: root bound 115141.0 against the optimum 115155; no feasible point on two of three seeds
